_classes.name: Word-swap reprint stored as a record (one renamed term in an otherwise reprinted duty, flagged extends_existing)

_classes.name: Content-list items and 'shall include the following' lead-ins stored as records (sub_item_of_parent gate misses them)
_classes.rule: lead_in matches /(shall|must) include(, but not be limited to)?( the following( provisions)?)?:$/ OR quote ends with /shall include(, but not be limited to| the following( provisions)?)?:$/

_classes.name: Junk agency built from a passive subject or object (fund, system, website)
_classes.rule: no agency_group AND agency == actor_raw minus leading article (case-insensitive) AND lower(agency) starts with monies|moneys|website|notice|copy|report(s)|application|such|sexual offense evidence OR ends with fund|system|website|notice|evidence

_classes.name: Generic 'city, town or village' of a multi-locality special act collapsed to one named unit (known class: joint actors stored for one body)
_classes.rule: actor_raw matches /city, town or village|cities, towns,? and villages/i AND agency in (Cities, Towns, Villages)

_classes.name: Sunset extension stored as a duty (Oct 19 decision says power, extends true)
_classes.rule: kind duty AND extends_existing true AND quote matches /remain in full force and effect|expire and be deemed repealed|shall be repealed|shall expire/i

_classes.name: One-time setup duty (convene, establish, create, develop, promulgate, appoint) left with deadline none
_classes.rule: kind duty AND deadline_kind none AND recurrence one-time AND quote matches /\bshall (convene|establish|create|develop|promulgate|appoint)\b/i

_classes.name: Removal-at-pleasure power stored as a duty
_classes.rule: kind duty AND quote matches /removable at (his|her|his or her|the) pleasure/i

_classes.name: Distinct duty with its own clock dropped by condition_of_other_record
_classes.rule: data/dropped rule == condition_of_other_record AND quote matches /within (\w+|\d+) (days|months|years)|no later than|on or before/i

_classes.name: Infinitive power in a public-authority powers list dropped by designation_no_actor (and resolved to Counties)
_classes.rule: data/dropped rule == designation_no_actor AND quote matches /^(\d+\.\s*)?To [a-z]+/
